domains.name: General Knowledge (History, Geography, Science, Current Affairs)

exam_price_notes: INR 200 (~$2.40 USD) for IMA/INA/AFA entry. INR 100 (~$1.20 USD) for OTA; female candidates no fee. SC/ST candidates exempted from fee.
exam_rules: OMR-based objective papers (where applicable). Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer. Unattempted questions carry no penalty. No calculators or electronic devices permitted. Dark blue or black ballpoint pen only (not gel or ink pens). Candidates must report 30 minutes before commencement. Mobile phones strictly prohibited.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID required on exam day: Aadhaar card, passport, voter ID, or driving licence. Admit card (hall ticket) is mandatory and must be downloaded from the UPSC OTR portal before the exam.

lifecycle.summary: The UPSC is still conducting the Combined Defence Services Examination. Its press note of 3 September 2026 says 'Union Public Service Commission will be conducting the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026 on 13th September, 2026 (Sunday) all over India', and the Commission's published 'PROGRAMME OF EXAMINATIONS/RECRUITMENT TESTS (RTs) - 2027' schedules both 'C.D.S. Examination (I), 2027' and 'C.D.S. Examination (II), 2027'.

prerequisites.description: Indian citizen. Age: 19-25 years (IMA/INA/OTA), 19-22 (AFA). IMA: Bachelor's degree. AFA: Bachelor's with Physics/Mathematics at 10+2. INA: Bachelor's degree with Physics/Mathematics. OTA: Any bachelor's degree. Exam conducted twice yearly.

testing_centers.notes: Offline paper-based (OMR) examination conducted at designated centres in major cities across all states and union territories of India. Centre allocation done by UPSC; candidates cannot choose specific centres.
